title: Now on PC | Beyond Orbit
caption: Beyond Orbit now runs on PC with Google Play Games. WASD to fly, hold the mouse to shoot, 1 to 4 or the wheel to switch weapons. Same pilot, bigger sky.
verified: hud.gd desktop input (WASD, MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, 1-4/Q/E/wheel); capture_pc.gd + make_bo_pc.py, 1.1.16 (72) LIVE 11.11.
